title: Investigation of the Effect of the NH···OC Hydrogen Bond from Cys69 to PYP Chromophore Using Novel Active-center Model Compound
abstract: Abstract                A PYP active-center model compound containing a hydrogen bond to the conjugated carbonyl oxygen was synthesized and its effect on the electronic properties of the chromophore were investigated. The intramolecular hydrogen bond induces significant change in the absorption maximum of the π–π* transition in the chromophore.
